text.p: Americana Gold and Diamond Holdings Inc said Thursday its management is meeting corporate financiers to raise funds to make sure the company's La Fortuna concession in Venezuela reaches full potential.
It said alternatives with other mining companies in the La Fortuna area, about nine miles from Placer Dome Inc's Las Cristinas Concession, are also being examined.
Americana also said it is in contact with the Venezuela government and continues to make progress toward acquiring the Bochinchito 4 Concession, which would add to its assets.
Exploration continues on the company's currently held Bochinchito concessions, it said, and announced positive results from trenching on the La Fortuna concession.
The company said new trenching results show three mineralized zones, La Fortuna Zone, El Foco Zone and the Central Zone, having significant promise.
